Why would hoarding a matellic element be worth more than hoarding a stack of paper or a certain sequance of 1s and 0s on a bank computer? My problem with a central bank is my problem with all centralized forms of control. They may promote stability (though certainly not always) but they do so at a significant cost of not allowing the market actors to price currencies based on the supply and demand of the market. Using pure market forces can cause a lot of disruption, but it is also better at allocating things where they are most desired and can be used most efficiently which in the end produces the best results for society.

Perhaps the combination of a non-centralized banking system with purely fiat money introduces too many variables and would result in economic disruption harmful to people (especially those owning fewer assets, particularly productive assets).
